title: [mime-tree] Fix base64/QP decode error paths
description: Skoll HIGH-1 + MEDIUM-2: (1) Base64 decode returns empty Vec on any error, losing all decoded bytes even when error is only at the tail. Consider permissive decoder or chunk-based decode preserving the decodable prefix. (2) QP decode error returns raw encoded bytes (with =XX sequences still in them), inconsistent with base64/UU paths that return empty. Either return empty consistently or document the divergence.
close_reason: Switched base64 engine to forgiving DecodePaddingMode::Indifferent for real-world email tolerance. Changed QP error path to return Vec::new() for consistency with base64 and UU. Added tests for missing-padding tolerance and invalid-char error.
